subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` boolean and `parentPeer` inbound-envelope helper extension as the canonical Google Chat DM thread-session shape, or should the work consolidate with the existing `sessionThread`/`threadSessionMode` proposals?
rationale: The source implementation is plausible, but the change creates public config and SDK surface while related Google Chat thread-session work uses different option names and broader scope.

options.title: Accept This Shape After Proof
options.body: Approve `threadSessions` plus the `parentPeer` helper direction, then require current-head live proof and generated baseline updates before merge.

options.title: Rename Or Consolidate First
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose the long-term option name and scope shared with the older thread-session work.

options.title: Defer To Broader Google Chat Plan
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one combined plan for DM threads, Space threads, and all-message ingestion.

recommendation.title: Accept This Shape After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve `threadSessions` plus the `parentPeer` helper direction, then require current-head live proof and generated baseline updates before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across routing, Plugin SDK, and Google Chat reply/session surfaces and is best positioned to choose the public API direction.
